display_name: Anthropic Claude Code (Agent tool, SendMessage, ListAgents, TaskStop)

isolated.notes: Agent-tool subagents start without the parent conversation; pass the full handoff in prompt.

spawn.notes: Observed 2026-09-16: Agent with run_in_background true launches an async subagent and returns its id. The id is always returned on this host, so the Supervisor must relay it; without it the spawned role cannot bind its identity and coordinator-preflight reports hostIdentityVerified false.

direction_update.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: sending to a RUNNING agent replies "queued for delivery at its next tool round" and starts no turn.

idle_continuation.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: the same tool sent to an IDLE or completed agent replies "Resuming agent" and starts a turn. Target state, not the tool, decides which operation this is.

wait.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: a notification arrives each time the agent stops, carrying status completed or killed; the same task id notifies again after a resume.

interrupt_turn.reason: No turn-only interrupt; TaskStop stops the agent task.

close.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: stopping an agent also ends the shell command it was running, and the stop arrives as a task notification with status killed. A stopped agent is not terminal; resume_closed still revives it.

observe.notes: Observed 2026-09-16: the main thread lists its subagents with ids and lifecycle state, but a subagent cannot call ListAgents at all. A Coordinator running as a subagent therefore observes runtimes through spawn receipts, not through this operation.

resume_closed.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: a completed agent and an agent stopped through close both resume from their own transcript and keep their original instructions.

turn_steer.reason: SendMessage queues for the next tool round only.

usage_read.reason: No usage method exposed to the model.

task_create.reason: Agent subagents run inside this session and cannot be relied on to host a four-role delivery in their own worktree. The user starts a separate session in a new worktree with the CREATE_TASK prompt and reports its name and paths.

task_message.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: delivery is acknowledged synchronously; see direction_update and idle_continuation for how the target state changes the effect.

task_wait.notes: One-shot idle notice from a session on this machine; re-subscribe after each notice. The tool schema still lists message as required with an empty default, so send an empty message for a pure subscription.

task_list.notes: Observed 2026-09-16: same tool and same depth limit as observe. Reconciling an uncertain creation from inside a subagent requires the user or the host UI.

wake_schedule.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: CronCreate returns a job id, CronList shows it and CronDelete cancels it. Session-only, fires only while idle, recurring jobs expire after 7 days.

project_discover.reason: The session working directory is the project; confirm it with git rev-parse --show-toplevel.

requires: Observed 2026-09-15/16: a full four-role delivery reached SHIP in this mode.

thread.reason: Agent subagents run inside this session; task_create is unavailable, so there is no independently addressable runtime to host a role.
